home.title: Home Hyperbaric Chamber | Personal Use at Home | HBOT Chamber Tech
home.desc: A single-person hyperbaric chamber for your home: Oslo (reclining) and Dubai (seated). Enter your room size and see on the plan whether it fits.
home.h1: A personal hyperbaric chamber for your home
home.lead: No membership, no appointments, no commute. Plan your session around your own schedule, in the quiet of your home.
home.intro_title: The most personal room in the house
intro: A home chamber makes the session part of your daily routine: before the day begins or when the house quiets down in the evening.

Oslo is a single-person chamber used fully horizontally; its 200×80 cm orthopedic bed offers a comfortable position for longer sessions. Dubai is the compact, seated model; with its 120×110 cm footprint it can fit into the corner of a room.
features: Fits your living space
Exterior color and interior upholstery are chosen in the configurator; the chamber is prepared for your home, not for a facility.
Easy to use
Touchscreen control makes it simple to start, monitor and finish a session.
Connected and monitored
CityConnect™ is standard: remote monitoring, instant alerts and cloud backup.
Safe by engineering
Aircraft-grade aluminum body, dual safety valve and built-in backup power supply.
faq: How much space do I need at home?

The chamber's outer dimensions and the access clearance around it are what matter. Dubai measures 120×110 cm and Oslo 240×110 cm outside. You can enter your room size in the planner above to see the approximate layout; the exact placement is confirmed during the site survey.
Will the chamber fit through my door?
The access route and door width are checked during the survey. Sharing dimensions, photos and the floor plan speeds up the assessment.
How loud is it during operation?
Oslo and Dubai run below 60 dB (CitySilent™).
What happens in a power outage?
All models come standard with a built-in backup power supply for power outages.
Which model suits a home?
Oslo stands out if you want reclining use; Dubai if you want a smaller footprint and seated use. Tokyo can be considered for two-person use.

spa.title: Hyperbaric Chambers for Spa and Wellness Centers | HBOT Chamber Tech
spa.desc: Single, double and four-person hyperbaric chambers for spa and wellness centers. Try on the plan how many chambers fit your space.
spa.h1: Add a hyperbaric experience to your spa menu
spa.lead: From a single-person chamber to a four-person premium chamber, scale to your session volume and your space.
spa.intro_title: A new ritual for your guests
intro: In wellness centers, the chamber is positioned as a separate experience alongside massage and relaxation areas. Double chambers (Tokyo) suit couples and friends, while the four-person Milano suits group sessions.
How many chambers you need depends on your daily session count and your space. In the planner, increase the quantity to see how many chambers fit in the same room with their access clearance.
features: Scalable
Start with one chamber and, as demand grows, add new ones in the same space or the next room.
Fits your brand
Exterior color, interior upholstery and lighting are chosen to match your spa's design language.
Easy operations
Touch control and CityConnect™ let you monitor sessions, with alerts visible instantly.
Quiet and uninterrupted
A noise level below 60 dB and a built-in backup power supply are standard.
faq: How many chambers does my spa need?

Share your daily session target, session length and opening hours, and we will work out the number of chambers and the layout together. The planner lets you see in advance how many chambers fit your space.
One multi-person chamber or several single-person chambers?
If group and couple sessions are your focus, Tokyo or Milano; if personalized programs are, several Dubai units are more flexible. Mixed setups are also possible.
Will the chamber match my spa's design?
Exterior color and interior upholstery are chosen in the configurator; special requests are settled together when you order.

hotel.title: Hyperbaric Chambers for Hotels | Wellness Suites and Hotel Spas | HBOT Chamber Tech
hotel.desc: Hyperbaric chambers for hotel suites and hotel spas. See on the plan how the chamber fits your room and offer your guests an exclusive experience.
hotel.h1: An exclusive hyperbaric experience for your hotel guests
hotel.lead: As part of a wellness suite or in the hotel spa, the chamber becomes a space that sets your guest experience apart.
hotel.intro_title: In the suite or in the spa
intro: In wellness suites, a single or double chamber (Oslo, Tokyo) can be designed as part of the room. In hotel spas, multi-person chambers such as Milano make group sessions possible.
In the planner, choose the hotel room setting to see how the chamber sits alongside the bed and seating area.
features: Fits the interior design
Exterior color and interior upholstery are chosen to suit your hotel's concept.
Guest-friendly use
Sessions start easily on the touchscreen; staff monitor remotely with CityConnect™.
Quiet operation
A noise level below 60 dB preserves the calm of the room and spa setting.
Uninterrupted service
A built-in backup power supply is standard; a scheduled service program is offered.
faq: Will the chamber fit in a hotel room?
You can enter your room size in the planner to see the approximate layout. The exact placement, transport route and door clearance are confirmed during the survey.
Which model suits a suite?
Oslo stands out for single-person reclining use and Tokyo for couples. In a spa area, Milano can be considered for group sessions.
How do maintenance and service work?
Installation, commissioning, staff training and the maintenance scope are documented in the project plan.

gym.title: Hyperbaric Chambers for Gyms and Sports Clubs | HBOT Chamber Tech
gym.desc: Single and multi-person hyperbaric chambers for gyms, clubs and team facilities. Try on the plan how many chambers fit your gym.
gym.h1: A hyperbaric chamber for your gym and your team
gym.lead: Plan the session space for your members or athletes around the layout of your facility.
intro: In clubs and gyms, the chamber is planned so that several people can use it at the same time. Tokyo Plus and Milano suit shared sessions, while Dubai suits individual sessions.
In the planner, choose the gym setting, increase the quantity and see how many chambers fit with their access clearance alongside the treadmills and the weights area.
features: Shared capacity
Multi-person chambers let several users share the same session.
Scalable installation
Add new chambers as your membership grows; plan the layout from the start.
Traceable operations
Sessions and alerts are monitored remotely with CityConnect™.
Durable build
Aircraft-grade aluminum body and dual safety valve.
faq: How many chambers fit in my gym?
Enter your gym's dimensions in the planner and increase the quantity to see. The exact layout and technical infrastructure are confirmed during the survey.
Which model suits a team facility?
Tokyo Plus or Milano stand out for several athletes at once, Dubai for individual programs.
